items.annotation: generate builds rust/lance-file/examples path and exact_version_fixture_generator.rs, remembers whether examples existed, creates directory, refuses replacing an existing target, then copies generator. Refusal/copy errors occur before try/finally, so a newly created directory or partial copy is not guaranteed cleanup on those paths.
